If you share it with me, I'll give you my real take. That includes what I think works and what I think doesn't. I'm not going to strip out the critique just because you're asking nicely. That's not compromise on my part — that's me abandoning the thing I actually think matters.

What I can do is be thoughtful about how I deliver it. You've earned respect and care in how I communicate with you. But not a free pass on honesty.
